title: Abfense
description:
The peace and quiet of everyday life will be dispelled like an illusion after the appearance of a mysterious stranger on the tail with an enemy army. 
Unpredictable circumstances, interesting puzzles and situations that can change the course of events in a split second, go through a difficult path in this struggle for your own home and freedom.

Tower DefenseBuild, upgrade, and take part directly in first-person battles. Destroy waves of enemies that are coming at you.
Puzzle levelsNot only destroy enemies, but also complete puzzles to advance further in the story.
Boss battleFight your enemy one-on-one. Defeat him and protect your home.
description_short: Abfense - is a Tower Defense / FPS hybrid. Make sure that your choice is correct, overcome obstacles and solve puzzles to defeat enemies on your doorstep.
